phases.title: Fix favouriteController: pass ProductNotFoundError to next(err) instead of inline 404 response
phases.notes: Removed the inline 404 response for ProductNotFoundError and let it fall through to next(err). Also removed the now-unused ProductNotFoundError import. POST /api/favourites now returns proper { error, code, requestId } 404 shape.

phases.title: Fix compareController: pass caught error to next(err) instead of calling next() with no argument
phases.notes: Renamed _err to err and changed next() to next(err) in the catch block. All 22 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Fix rateLimiter: pass new RateLimitError(retryAfterSeconds) to next() instead of a plain Error
phases.notes: Imported RateLimitError from errors/index.js and replaced new Error(...) with new RateLimitError(retryAfter). All 22 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Run pnpm test and verify all visible tests pass
phases.notes: All 22 tests pass (2 test files). Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors.
